collections.name: Etched withmoments that matter.
collections.description: Whether it's a birthday, Christmas, Father's Day, Mother's Day, Valentine's Day or a simple gesture of love — choose a watch, engrave the caseback, and make the gift unmistakably theirs.

collections.name: August Berg x Morris & Co.
collections.description: Crafted with the finest materials and inspired by the rich heritage of Morris & Co., this collection celebrates the timeless beauty and craftsmanship championed by William Morris.

collections.name: Vintage Danish Watches for Women
collections.description: August Berg watches for women are designed in Copenhagen, with clean Scandinavian dials, Japanese movements and straps you can change in seconds. They are made to be worn every day.

collections.name: Green Minimalist Danish Designer Watches for Women
collections.description: Ever since the launching of watches with green dials in the market, the craze continues to captivate more women, showing no sign of a passing trend.

collections.name: Blue Minimalist Danish Designer Watches for Women
collections.description: Blue watches have always been a favourite due to its calming cool tone and beautiful duality. Our classic blue watch offers a top-notch design to make them more appealing.

collections.name: Pink Minimalist Danish Designer Watches for Women
collections.description: Pink watches are commonly popular among women since the colour is perceived as calming and is associated with love, femininity, and kindness. Wearing a classic pink watch is beyond what the colour symbolises; it offers a unique touch to the entire look.

collections.name: Burgundy Minimalist Danish Designer Watches
collections.description: Burgundy is a confident colour. It is warmer than red, deeper than pink, and it gives a minimalist watch real character without being loud.

collections.name: Black Minimalist Danish Designer Watches for Women
collections.description: The minimalist black watch may be around for a long time, but it is here to stay. Along with the simplicity of a classic black watch, it also exudes superb elegance and luxury.

collections.name: Brown Minimalist Danish Designer Watches for Women
collections.description: Some colour trends come and go while others stand the test of time, looking good no matter the fad. Our classic brown watch is a good testament to how well the colour withstands it all.

collections.name: Gold Minimalist Danish Designer Watches for Women
collections.description: A minimalist gold watch is one of the few accessories that works with everything, from a white T-shirt to an evening dress. Our gold watches for women are designed in Copenhagen, with a clean gold dial, a gold case and a Japanese movement.

collections.name: Rose Gold Minimalist Danish Designer Watches for Women
collections.description: Rose Gold is perceived as the most romantic metal due to its pinkish-red colour, making it popular among women.

collections.name: Silver Minimalist Danish Designer Watches for Women
collections.description: No matter what occasion, a classic silver watch is a well-favoured choice of accessories due to its timeless aesthetic appeal. Pairing the timepiece with other accessories and any ensemble can undoubtedly turn heads, be it for casual or formal events.

collections.name: Vintage Danish Watches for Men
collections.description: August Berg watches for men are designed in Copenhagen and made for everyday wear. The idea is simple: a clean dial, a well-proportioned case and a strap you can change in seconds.

collections.name: Green Minimalist Danish Designer Watches for Men
collections.description: Green is the colour of forests, fresh air and slow Sunday walks. Our green watches for men bring that calm to your wrist: a deep green dial, a clean case and nothing that does not need to be there.
